description: Source code for FreeType API functions related to CID font information, including functions to get CID registry, check if a face is CID-keyed, and retrieve CID from glyph index.

methods.name: FT_Get_CID_Registry_Ordering_Supplement
methods.description: Retrieves the CID registry, ordering, and supplement information for a given font face.

methods.name: FT_Get_CID_Is_Internally_CID_Keyed
methods.description: Checks if the font face is internally CID-keyed.

methods.name: FT_Get_CID_From_Glyph_Index
methods.description: Gets the CID from a glyph index in the font face.
